summary: Add an opt-in collection-window load profile with snapshot budgets and full-card parity

replay.detail: Test workload only; production graph replay and startup are unchanged.

schema.detail: No production or checkpoint schema changes; generated load fixture schema is unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, admission policy, writer behavior or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: No client protocol changes. Load reports include a profile identity and optional collection counts. Legacy reports retain the agents-only profile; comparisons reject mixed or different profiles.

downtime.detail: No serving code changes or deployment restart required by this measurement change.

manual.detail: The canonical release daemon_load command keeps its agents-only workload. Set ST_LOAD_PROFILE=collections-v1 explicitly for all four held collections and use a baseline from that same profile.

recovery.detail: Unset ST_LOAD_PROFILE to use the canonical agents-only workload; no production database state changes.
